checks: Conditional Jensen bounds E||M||^4 by the fixed Gaussian fourth moment, giving tightness and uniform quadratic-tail integrability. Continuous truncations pass the martingale identity to weak limits; bounded continuous tests determine its signed measure, proving closed feasible couplings.

At most quadratic continuous costs have continuous expectations under this moment control. Adding a lower-bounded lsc posterior-mean cost finite somewhere gives attainment, implemented by disintegration on standard Borel spaces; arbitrary kernel costs need the explicit invariance assumption.

E[omega*M^T]=E[M*M^T] gives the affine trace identity. Whitened noisy coordinates realize all covariance eigenvalues t in[0,1], including omitted t=0 and exact t=1. Sign disclosure yields a two-point posterior mean; singleton-zero/else-one cost is lsc and gives strict gap from Gaussian linear posterior means.
